mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 73 degrees at Verona Community Park under clear skies with an air quality index of 54. The moon is full tonight, and you might spot the International Space Station passing from the west-northwest over Cross Plains toward the northeast near Home Depot starting at 3:26 AM for one minute. The temperature will dip to a low of 63 degrees overnight with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has several important updates. Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September as Hunger Action Month to help the 1 in 8 residents facing food insecurity. Additionally, keep an eye out for flagging on Highway M on August 31 and September 1 for utility work, which may cause minor traffic delays.

There is plenty to do in town. Live music is happening today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmer's Market or live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, we have the Kids Triathlon and Girls Try Hockey event this Saturday, August 30.

In our weekly police report, on August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop for expired registration and cited the driver for possession of marijuana after smelling the substance inside the vehicle.
Today's flavor is OREO Cookie Overload. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
